A square generative composition in dark cobalt blue and warm white. Large blue fields occupy the upper right and lower left. White T forms descend through the lower-left field, with a small white F at the left edge. The lower-right area combines a thin horizontal rule, vertical lines, an offset blue block, and a dense rectangular pattern.
